items.raw_excerpt: The cost of fixing storm damage inflicted on Whangārei district roads earlier this year has risen to more than $23 million - of which almost $11m has been spent clearing one giant landslide.
items.summary_en: Fixing storm damage on roads in the Whangarei district now costs more than $23 million. Almost $11 million of that was spent to clear one big landslide. The storms hit the roads earlier this year.
items.summary_ko: 올해 초 폭풍 피해를 본 퍼랑아레이 지역 도로 복구 비용이 2300만 달러를 넘어섰다. 그중 거의 1100만 달러는 큰 산사태 하나를 치우는 데 쓰였다.
items.title_en: Whangarei road repairs cost more than $23 million

items.title_original: Cost of fixing storm-damaged Whangārei roads balloons to more than $23m

items.raw_excerpt: I used to have the patience to fix anything.
items.summary_en: This article asks readers if they are the kind of people who fix broken things. The writer says they used to have the patience to fix anything. It looks at how people feel about repairing everyday items.
items.summary_ko: 이 기사는 독자들에게 물건을 고치는 편인지 묻습니다. 필자는 예전에는 무엇이든 고칠 인내심이 있었다고 말합니다. 일상 물건을 수리하는 마음가짐을 돌아봅니다.
items.title_en: Are You a Fixer of Things?

items.summary_en: Strong winds blew across the Attica region of Greece. The Fire Service took dozens of calls to cut trees and remove loose objects. Crews worked to keep the area safe.

items.raw_excerpt: A woman was escorted off a Batik Air flight at Singapore's Changi Airport after refusing to hand a large cardboard box to cabin crew, delaying departure by about an hour.
items.summary_en: A woman was escorted off a Batik Air flight at Singapore's Changi Airport. She refused to hand a large cardboard box to the cabin crew. The dispute delayed the flight by about one hour.
items.summary_ko: 여성이 싱가포르 창이공항에서 바틱에어 여객기에서 강제로 내렸다. 그녀가 큰 카드보드 상자를 승무원에게 넘기기를 거부했기 때문이다. 이 일로 항공편이 약 한 시간 늦어졌다.
items.title_en: Passenger taken off flight at Singapore Changi airport over cardboard box
